purpose: Consolidate S1 and S2 into one executable contract, common adapter interface, semantic measurements and defect handoff without changing source workbenches.
mode: read-only federation over immutable S1 and S2 builds
protected: human geometry, rig, skin, camera and settings
shoe geometry, material and design state
pattern coordinates, topology, seams and allowances
forbidden: infer anatomical height from generic bounds
infer footwear size from model bounds
claim manufacturing, fit, physical or aesthetic certification
deliverables: one unified interactive entry for S1 human, S1 footwear and S2 pattern
actual browser evidence and immutable public URL
acceptanceGates: same-source S1 human and shoe observations
same-source S2 pattern observation with private fragment key
separate PASS FAIL WARNING UNKNOWN NOT_APPLICABLE counters
defect export without automatic repair authority
fixed public byte and browser verification
